svg.aria-label: Verdict plane of the dual-dataset test, one panel per update type
svg.text: Where each kind of update lands in the dual-dataset test
One dot = one client update, placed by the relative loss drift of its replica (step 0.5) on the two golden sets.
5 seeds (20261110–20261114), oracle trajectory. Grey areas are rejected as Fraud.
